stages.name: Orientation and Baseline
stages.objective: Teach the teacher-student interaction pattern and establish a low-pressure reading/written-expression baseline.

stages.name: Direct Concepts
stages.objective: Recognize, retrieve, and use representative canonical concepts directly.

stages.name: Change the Word
stages.objective: Use already-authorized predictable morphology to generate lawful forms without treating them as new lexical slots.

stages.name: Build the Sentence
stages.objective: Use grammar and numeration with known concepts to construct complete written meanings.

stages.name: Build the Meaning
stages.objective: Express an idea when the exact target word is unavailable by controlled composition and semantically equivalent paraphrase.

stages.name: Read and Respond
stages.objective: Apply the architecture to practical written situations and produce context-appropriate written responses.

stages.name: Unseen Transfer
stages.objective: Measure transfer on written situations and combinations not previously presented in the learner's instructional history.

stages.name: Phase 1 Completion
stages.objective: Reassess representative Phase 1 competencies, summarize evidence, and issue the durable Phase 1 completion checkpoint.

completion_law.stage_pass_criteria_rule: Each stage's exact competency criteria must be frozen with its content before a learner attempts that stage; criteria cannot be weakened after seeing the learner's response.
completion_law.phase1_complete_when: All required stage checkpoints through P1S8 are durably confirmed.

unseen_transfer_separation.rule: Items used for P1S7 transfer measurement may not previously appear as instructional or practice items for that learner.
unseen_transfer_separation.reuse_after_first_measurement: Once exposed, an item may be used for later practice but no longer counts as first-exposure transfer evidence.

architecture_ancestry.diagnostic_pattern: ASSESS -> LOCATE -> GUIDE -> REPAIR -> REASSESS -> ADVANCE
architecture_ancestry.use: Progression logic only; no requirement to copy Coheriscope visual presentation.
